main_text.l: עֶדֶן m. עֶדְנָה f. Voluptas, Oblectatio, plural. עֲדָנִים Delicia.
עֲדִינוֹ Adino, proprium nomen juxta quosdam; aliis Voluptas ejus, Volupe ipsi, quasi àseparato עֲדִין.
עֶדְנָא עֶדֶן m. Chald. Tempus: plurale, עִדְנַיָּא עִדְנִין.
עָרַף Redundare; Abundare, Superesse, Superfluum esse. Hiphil הֶעְדִּיף idem.
עָדַר Ordinare, Disponere aciem militarem. Niphal נֶעְדַּר Deesse, Desiderari: item Sarriri, Resarriri, Pastinari. Pihel עִדֵּר
עָדָשׁ m. Lens lentis: plur. עֲדָשִׁים.
עָב m. Nubes densa, plur. עָבִים & עֲבוֹת.
עֻגָה, עֲנָה, עוּגָה f. Placenta, proprie in carbonibus tosta: plur. עֻגוֹת.

page.notes: Hebrew and vowel pointing read from a small, partly blurred scan; the pointed forms in the entries (especially the Chaldee forms, the Pihel form and the Hiphil forms) may contain errors in vowels and dots. Marginal stains and show-through omitted.
